facts_found: All credit card rewards are stored as 'points' in the transaction database due to an incomplete legacy backend migration, even on cash back cards; for cash back cards 1 point = $0.01 when redeemed as a statement credit or Rho-Bank checking account credit (e.g., 250 points = $2.50, matching 2.5% on a $100 purchase). [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_006]

Cash back cards include Bronze Rewards, Silver Rewards, Gold Rewards, Platinum Rewards, Diamond Elite, Crypto-Cash Back, Green Rewards, Silver Zoom, Business Bronze/Silver/Gold/Platinum Rewards; the only true points-based card is EcoCard (5 sustainability points per $1 green, 1 point per $1 other), which also redeems at $0.01 per point. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_006]

All credit card rewards points are rounded DOWN (floored) to the nearest whole number, not rounded to nearest; this applies across all card types and reward categories. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_007]
Example of flooring: a $126.77 purchase at 1% earns 126 points (not 127); a $99.99 purchase at 2.5% calculates to 249.975 points but awards 249 points. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_007]
Rewards on a purchase = purchase amount x the card's cash back rate (Diamond Elite example: purchase amount x 5.0%). [doc_credit_cards_diamond_elite_card_003]
Rewards accrue when transactions post (typically within a few days of purchase date), not at authorization. [doc_credit_cards_diamond_elite_card_003]

Each billing cycle statement shows new rewards earned, prior balance, redemptions, and any adjustments for returns; a returned purchase reverses the associated cash back. [doc_credit_cards_diamond_elite_card_003]

Rewards are calculated on the posted amount of each eligible purchase; returned/refunded purchases reverse the rewards; disputed transactions do not earn rewards until resolved and posted. [doc_credit_cards_bronze_rewards_card_002]
Typically ineligible transactions: fees, interest charges, and cash-like/cash-equivalent transactions (e.g., some money transfers). [doc_credit_cards_bronze_rewards_card_002]
Pending transactions do not earn rewards until they settle and post; monthly statement and online account show rewards earned by cycle and in total. [doc_credit_cards_bronze_rewards_card_003]

Platinum Rewards Card earns 10.0% on all eligible purchases; not eligible: cash advances, balance transfers, fees, interest and other cash-equivalent transactions; rewards accrue when transactions post and become available after clearing any return window. [doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_002]

Silver Rewards Card: 4.0% on eligible travel and software; rewards are calculated after posting, not at authorization; third-party wallets and processors may alter merchant classification; gift cards, person-to-person payments, fees, interest and bank-charged insurance premiums typically do not qualify; pending earnings may adjust if the merchant updates the transaction or issues a credit. [doc_credit_cards_silver_rewards_card_002]

Green Rewards Card: 3.0% at sustainable/eco-friendly merchants, 1.0% on other eligible purchases; cash equivalents, balance transfers and certain fees earn nothing; reversed/refunded transactions forfeit rewards in the period the adjustment posts. [doc_business_credit_cards_green_rewards_card_004]

Business Gold Rewards Card: 2.5% on eligible operations purchases, 1.0% otherwise; cash back is calculated based on the merchant category code assigned by the merchant's payment processor, and rewards appear after the transaction posts and clears. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_gold_rewards_card_002]

Business Platinum Rewards Card: 4.0% on travel, software and media advertising, 1.5% other; cash back is calculated on net purchases after returns or credits, and merchants must submit the transaction under an eligible category code to get the enhanced rate. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_platinum_rewards_card_002]

Crypto-Cash Back earns 2.0% on eligible purchases, redeemable to crypto once the balance reaches at least $30; reviewing merchant processing categories in statements confirms which transactions earned the 2.0% rate. [doc_credit_cards_crypto-cash_back_001]

Business Bronze Rewards Card earns 1.0% on eligible purchases, calculated on the net transaction amount after credits or returns, with cash back credited at the end of each billing cycle per program rules. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_bronze_rewards_card_002]

Redemption values: statement credit and Rho-Bank checking credit are 1 point = $0.01 with a 500-point ($5.00) minimum; travel portal 1 point = $0.0125 (2,500-point minimum); gift cards 0.8-1 cent/point (1,000-point minimum); charitable donations 1 cent/point (250-point minimum); merchandise 0.5-0.8 cent/point; airline transfers 1 point = 1 mile in 1,000-point increments (Gold, Platinum, Diamond Elite, Business Platinum only). [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_008]

[doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_021]

Customer service investigation of a cash back discrepancy involves looking up the specific transaction, verifying the merchant category, checking the applicable reward rates for the card, and determining whether an adjustment is needed; if the customer was shortchanged, the correct amount is applied to the account. Information needed to investigate a cash back discrepancy: transaction date, merchant name and purchase amount, cash back received versus expected, and any receipts/documentation. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_021]

facts_found: Silver Rewards Card earns at least 1.0% back on non-category (everyday) purchases. [doc_credit_cards_silver_rewards_card_008]
Silver Rewards Card rewards are based on the merchant's submitted category; transactions must post before rewards are calculated (not at authorization). [doc_credit_cards_silver_rewards_card_002]

Silver Rewards Card transactions that typically do not qualify: gift cards, person-to-person payments, fees, interest, bank-charged insurance premiums, and returned/refunded purchases (rewards reversed when credits post). [doc_credit_cards_silver_rewards_card_002]
EcoCard earns 5 sustainability points per dollar on green purchases at qualifying green merchants and 1 sustainability point per dollar on other purchases. [doc_credit_cards_ecocard_002]

EcoCard is the only true points-based Rho-Bank card (5 points per $1 green, 1 point per $1 other) and its points redeem at $0.01 per point as statement credit or checking account credit. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_006]

EcoCard green purchases include public transportation fares, EV charging, renewable energy subscriptions, certified sustainable retailers/eco-labeled products, and bike share/micromobility; gift cards and cash equivalents typically do not qualify. [doc_credit_cards_ecocard_003]

EcoCard merchants excluded from the 5 points per dollar rate (earning the standard 1 point per dollar): Target, Walmart, Amazon (all channels, including eco-labeled items and Amazon-processed marketplace orders) and ThredUp. [doc_credit_cards_ecocard_004]
EcoCard EV charging qualifies for the higher 5 points per dollar rate only on Tesla Supercharger, ChargePoint, or EVgo. [doc_credit_cards_ecocard_004]
EcoCard mixed carts at non-partner merchants may earn the entire purchase at the non-green rate; refunds reverse points at the original earn rate. [doc_credit_cards_ecocard_002]
Crypto-Cash Back earns rewards at 2.0% on eligible purchases, with a flat rate confirmed by reviewing merchant processing categories in statements. [doc_credit_cards_crypto-cash_back_001]
Crypto-Cash Back rewards can be redeemed to crypto once the reward balance reaches at least 30 dollars; no bonus category rates are documented for this card. [doc_credit_cards_crypto-cash_back_001]

Business Platinum Rewards Card earns 4.0% on travel, software and media advertising purchases and 1.5% on purchases outside those categories. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_platinum_rewards_card_002]

Business Platinum Rewards Card cash back is calculated on net purchases after returns or credits; cash equivalents, balance transfers and fees do not earn cash back. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_platinum_rewards_card_002]

Business Platinum software/cloud purchases earn 4.0% when coded as software or cloud services, otherwise 1.5%; hardware, peripherals, professional services and uncategorized telecom charges are excluded from 4.0%. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_platinum_rewards_card_007]

Business Platinum media advertising purchases earn 4.0% only when the merchant submits the charge under an advertising or media category; agency retainers, PR, talent fees and intermediary-billed invoices typically do not qualify. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_platinum_rewards_card_003]
All credit card rewards points are rounded down (floored) to the nearest whole point, consistently across all card types and reward categories. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_007]

Every Rho-Bank card has a base reward rate applying to all purchases plus bonus categories; recognized categories are Travel, Dining, Groceries, Entertainment, Shopping, Utilities, Transportation, Software, Media, Green/Sustainable, Operations, and Other. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_019]

Statement credit and Rho-Bank checking credit redeem at 1 point = $0.01 with a 500-point ($5.00) minimum; EcoCard redemptions require at least 3,000 points at $0.01 per point. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_008]

Green Account (savings) pairing: eligible purchases at eco-certified merchants can earn an extra 2.0% cash back bonus when using an EcoCard, in addition to the standard EcoCard earn rates, and this requires the card to be linked to and in good standing on the Green Account.
